name: tr
description: Translate: reads standard input and replaces each character of SET1 with the matching character of SET2. Sets accept ranges (a-z) and classes ([:upper:], [:digit:], [:space:]). tr never reads a file directly: you send it text through a pipe or a < redirection.

options.description: Deletes the characters of SET1 instead of replacing them.
Squeezes repeats of the same character into a single one (several spaces → one).
Uses the complement of SET1: every character not in it.
Truncates SET1 to the length of SET2.

arguments.name: SET2
arguments.description: Replacement characters, in the same order.

examples.explanation: Removes the carriage returns from a file created on Windows.
Replaces runs of spaces with a single space.
Prints each PATH directory on its own line.
Keeps only letters, digits and newlines.
